n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Hello again! Did you watch the match on Saturday?

translations.fa: دوباره سلام! شنبه مسابقه را دیدی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I did. What a game!

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: We lost, two-one. I went with Ryan. We didn't score until the ninetieth minute!

translations.fa: باختیم، دو-یک. با رایان رفتم. تا دقیقهٔ نود گل نزدیم!

branches.suggestion: That's bad luck. Did Ryan enjoy it?
Did you go to the stadium?

cultureNote.en: Brits say "two-one" for 2–1 and "nil" for zero: "We won one-nil."

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Yeah, we got the train to the ground. It was freezing! Ryan didn't bring a coat, of course.

translations.fa: آره، با قطار رفتیم ورزشگاه. یخ‌بندون بود! رایان طبق معمول کت نیاورد.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: He borrowed my scarf. Then he spilt his Bovril all over it!

translations.fa: شال‌گردن منو قرض گرفت. بعد بوریلش را ریخت روش!

branches.suggestion: Oh no! Did it wash out?
branches.suggestionFa: ای وای! با شستن پاک شد؟

cultureNote.en: Bovril is a hot, salty beef drink — a classic at British football grounds in winter.
cultureNote.fa: Bovril یک نوشیدنی داغ و شور گوشتی است، کلاسیک ورزشگاه‌های بریتانیا.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Leslie washed it twice. It still smells a bit beefy! Did you do anything nice at the weekend?

translations.fa: لزلی دوبار شستش. هنوز یه کم بوی گوشت میده! تو آخر هفته کار جالبی کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I didn't do much. I stayed at home and rested.
branches.suggestionFa: کار زیادی نکردم. خونه موندم و استراحت کردم.

branches.suggestion: I went to a museum. It was free!

cultureNote.en: Many big museums in Britain are free, like the British Museum and the Natural History Museum.
cultureNote.fa: بسیاری از موزه‌های بزرگ بریتانیا رایگان‌اند.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: Good for you. Right, here's your stop. Next Saturday, come to the match with us!

translations.fa: آفرین. خب، اینم ایستگاهت. شنبهٔ بعد با ما بیا مسابقه!
